_note: SAMPLE held-out test set. expected=null means the correct answer is 'not enough data'.

cases.text: Temperature alarm, it stops after about half an hour
cases.expected_root_cause: Oil cooler fins blocked with dust, reducing cooling.

cases.text: الكمبروسر بيطفي لحاله بعد نص ساعة وبيطلع انذار حرارة
cases.expected_root_cause: Oil cooler fins blocked with dust, reducing cooling.

cases.text: High temp alarm and the oil sight glass is almost empty
cases.expected_root_cause: Low oil level in the separator tank.

cases.text: Overheating within 10 minutes of start, the cooler is cold when I touch it
cases.expected_root_cause: Thermostatic (thermal bypass) valve stuck closed, oil bypasses the cooler.

cases.text: Cooling fan is not spinning
cases.expected_root_cause: Cooling fan motor failed or its overload relay tripped.

cases.text: Air delivery is low and pressure takes long to build up
cases.expected_root_cause: Air intake filter element clogged.

cases.text: انذار فرق ضغط السبريتر والامبير عالي
cases.expected_root_cause: Oil separator element clogged (end of service life).

cases.text: Production says there is oil coming out of the air tools, we are adding oil every week
cases.expected_root_cause: Scavenge line orifice or strainer blocked, oil collects in the separator and carries over.

cases.text: Compressor is running, motor on, but the pressure never goes up. No alarm.
cases.expected_root_cause: Inlet (intake) valve stuck closed or its diaphragm torn.

cases.text: It stays in unload mode
cases.expected_root_cause: Loading solenoid valve coil burnt or connector loose.

cases.text: Machine running loaded non stop and still the plant pressure is low, you can hear air hissing near line 2
cases.expected_root_cause: Air leaks in the distribution pipework, fittings or tools exceed compressor capacity.

cases.text: Display shows pressure 25 bar then 0 then 14, jumping around
cases.expected_root_cause: Pressure transducer failed or cable damaged.

cases.text: won't start, temperature shows -99
cases.expected_root_cause: Discharge temperature sensor (PT1000) open circuit or connector corroded.

cases.text: Main motor tripped on overload, it's a very hot day
cases.expected_root_cause: Main motor overload relay tripped due to high current (low supply voltage or high discharge pressure setting).

cases.text: After the electricity maintenance yesterday the compressor won't start, phase alarm
cases.expected_root_cause: Phase loss or wrong phase sequence on the incoming supply (blown fuse or supply work).

cases.text: Alarm E001 and I cannot reset it
cases.expected_root_cause: Emergency stop button pressed, or its contact block faulty.

cases.text: صوت صفير قوي وقت التشغيل والهوا قليل
cases.expected_root_cause: Drive belts worn or tension too low (belt-driven RS-37).

cases.text: Rumbling noise from the electric motor and a lot of vibration
cases.expected_root_cause: Main motor bearing worn or lacking grease.

cases.text: Water in the air lines at the packing machines, the auto drain never opens
cases.expected_root_cause: Electronic condensate drain valve blocked or its timer/strainer faulty.

cases.text: When I restart it right after stopping, it fails to start
cases.expected_root_cause: Blowdown (vent) valve not venting the sump at stop, so the motor restarts against pressure.

cases.text: Contactors clicking and chattering during start, motor stalls
cases.expected_root_cause: Worn star-delta contactor or faulty transition timer.

cases.text: There is oil on the floor under the compressor
cases.expected_root_cause: Oil leak from a hose, fitting or the oil filter gasket.

cases.text: Service due message, oil looks very dark
cases.expected_root_cause: Service interval exceeded; oil degraded and oil filter clogged.

cases.text: Dew point alarm and water in the lines
cases.expected_root_cause: Dryer condenser dirty or dryer drain blocked (RS-55 integrated dryer).

cases.text: Compressor loads and unloads every few seconds
cases.expected_root_cause: Pressure band too narrow or air receiver too small for the demand pattern.

Airend is seized, the motor hums but the screw won't turn even by hand
